name: Dalian Flow Battery Energy Storage Peak-shaving Power Station (Rongke Power), Dalian, Liaoning
description: Phase 1 100 MW / 400 MWh vanadium redox flow battery, first phase of a planned 200 MW / 800 MWh station; grid-connected 29 September 2022 with commercial operation from mid-October 2022 — the largest flow-battery station in the world at the time

sources.note: Chinese Academy of Sciences English feature on the DICP/Rongke Power Dalian station, read 2026-11-11
